# The Best Chocolate Advent Calendars for 2024

The seasonal treat-based countdown might these days have expanded into cosmetics and booze, but nothing beats 24 days of chocolate. As December approaches, the humble advent calendar remains a beloved tradition for children and adults alike, transforming the anticipation of Christmas into a daily moment of sweetness. This year, chocolatiers and confectionery brands have outdone themselves with offerings ranging from budget-friendly supermarket options to luxurious artisan creations.

***

For those seeking premium quality, independent chocolate makers have crafted stunning calendars that elevate the daily ritual into something truly special. Brands like Hotel Chocolat, Montezuma's, and Prestat are offering intricately designed boxes filled with single-origin truffles, salted caramels, and innovative flavour combinations. These higher-end options, typically priced between £25 and £50, promise a journey through different cocoa profiles and textures that will delight serious chocolate enthusiasts.

***

Budget-conscious families needn't miss out on the festive fun, however. Major supermarkets including Tesco, Sainsbury's, and Aldi have stepped up their game considerably, offering own-brand calendars that punch well above their weight. For under £5, shoppers can find calendars featuring creamy milk chocolate, and many retailers now stock options catering to dietary requirements, including vegan and free-from alternatives.

***

Sustainability has become an increasingly important consideration for environmentally conscious consumers. Several brands have responded by eliminating plastic windows, using recyclable cardboard, and sourcing ethically certified cocoa. Tony's Chocolonely and Divine Chocolate continue to lead the way with their commitment to fair trade practices, making their advent calendars guilt-free in more ways than one.

***

This article contains affiliate links to products. Our journalism is independent and is never written to promote these products although we may earn a small commission if a reader makes a purchase. Whether you're treating yourself or searching for the perfect gift, there's never been more choice in the chocolate advent calendar market, ensuring everyone can find their perfect countdown companion this Christmas season.
